adoption_seam.rationale: Pinned DungeonMind WorldGraphRepository public callables are ['get_head', 'get_revision', 'publish_revision', 'rollback_head']; none match adopt/bootstrap_complete/import_existing. There is no public governed adopt-existing-world service for pre-existing Buddy worlds.

blockers.smallest_next_change: Decide genesis policy A/B/C and add a durable adoption seam that preserves Buddy contribution/assertion reconstruction history.

examples: WorldGraphRepository methods: get_head, get_revision, publish_revision, rollback_head

Exercise Postgres adoption only after public seam exists.
